title: AEOeye vs Evertune: Free Instant Audit vs Enterprise GEO Analytics
metaDescription: AEOeye vs Evertune compared honestly: free instant multi-engine AI visibility audit vs a sales-gated enterprise GEO analytics platform from ~$3,000/mo.
shortAnswer: AEOeye gives you a free, instant blind audit across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini in minutes — no demo, contract, or commitment. Evertune is a sales-gated enterprise GEO platform (reported to start around $3,000/mo) that samples each prompt ~100 times for data-science-grade analytics and adds a US consumer panel. Choose AEOeye to quickly find out if AI recommends you; choose Evertune if you need high-volume statistical depth and can fund it.
intro:
If you're comparing AEOeye and Evertune, you're really comparing two different jobs. One answers "does AI recommend my brand, and who's winning instead?" in a few minutes for free. The other is a heavyweight analytics platform built to give large brands statistically rigorous, ongoing measurement of how AI talks about them.

Both are legitimate tools for the same broad problem — AI visibility — but they sit at opposite ends of the cost, depth, and accessibility spectrum. Here's an honest, specific breakdown so you can pick the one that actually fits your team and budget.

sections.heading: The core difference in one paragraph
sections.body:
AEOeye is a free, instant, self-serve audit. You enter your brand and the questions your buyers ask, and it queries ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini *blind* — no logins, no priming — then shows whether each engine recommends you, where you rank, and which competitors come up instead. You see results in minutes without a sales call or contract.

Evertune is an enterprise GEO/AEO analytics platform. Instead of a single query per question, it samples each tracked prompt roughly 100 times across 9+ engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Meta AI, DeepSeek, and Google's AI Mode/Overviews), generating 1M+ prompts per brand per month to produce statistically significant brand-visibility and sentiment metrics. It pairs that with a large US consumer panel. Access is sales-gated, with no public pricing and reported pricing starting around $3,000/month. In short: AEOeye optimizes for speed and access; Evertune optimizes for statistical depth and scale.

sections.heading: Where Evertune is genuinely stronger
sections.body:
We won't pretend otherwise — for large brands that need it, Evertune offers depth AEOeye doesn't try to match today.

- **Statistical rigor.** Sampling each prompt ~100 times smooths out the natural run-to-run randomness of AI models. A single query (what a quick audit gives you) is one draw from a noisy distribution; Evertune's volume produces stable, defensible metrics you can trend over time and put in front of a CMO.
- **High-volume, ongoing measurement.** 1M+ prompts per brand per month supports granular tracking across many prompts, engines, and time periods — useful for high-consideration categories like automotive, healthcare, and B2B SaaS.
- **Consumer panel signal.** Evertune layers in a proprietary US consumer panel, connecting AI-visibility data to real consumer behavior — something a pure blind-query tool can't replicate.
- **Enterprise track record.** Reported clients include Canada Goose, Miro, and WPP's Choreograph. If you're a large brand or agency that needs data-science-grade analytics and can fund it, Evertune is built for you.

sections.heading: Where AEOeye is genuinely stronger
sections.body:
AEOeye wins decisively on access, speed, and cost — the things that matter most when you just need an answer.

- **Free to start, no commitment.** You can run a real audit at no cost. Evertune has no free trial and no self-serve signup; every engagement reportedly begins with a 'Book a demo' call and a contract before you can even see pricing.
- **Instant results.** AEOeye returns a multi-engine read in minutes. With Evertune, the evaluation path runs through demos and procurement before you learn anything about your brand.
- **No ~$3k/mo floor.** Independent reviews repeatedly peg Evertune at roughly $3,000/month minimum — out of reach for small businesses, solo marketers, and most mid-market teams. AEOeye is sized for exactly those people.
- **Built for non-experts.** AEOeye's blind multi-engine audit is designed to be readable by someone who isn't a data scientist — clear 'do they recommend me, and who beats me?' output, not aggregate index scores you need training to interpret.
- **Global by default.** AEOeye queries the engines directly with no US-panel dependency, so it isn't skewed toward a US consumer base.

sections.heading: The honest trade-off
sections.body:
The fairest way to frame this: AEOeye and Evertune are not really competing for the same buyer.

AEOeye trades statistical depth for speed and access. A free, instant audit is one snapshot per engine — fantastic for discovering whether AI recommends you, who your AI-era competitors are, and whether you have a problem worth solving, but it's a starting point, not a 100x-sampled statistical model. AEOeye is also newer and lighter on enterprise analytics and long-run historical dashboards than incumbents; its deeper multi-engine querying activates with usage.

Evertune trades accessibility and cost for that depth. The ~100x sampling and consumer panel are real, valuable, and expensive — and they're gated behind sales, a contract, and a budget most teams don't have. Its insights also lean partly on a US consumer panel, which several reviews flag as less relevant for non-US brands.

So the question isn't 'which is better' — it's 'which job are you hiring for?'

sections.heading: Which should you choose?
sections.body:
**Choose AEOeye if** you want to know *today*, for free, whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini recommend your brand and who's winning instead. It's the right call for small and mid-market businesses, solo marketers, agencies running quick client checks, and anyone who wants an answer without a demo, contract, or ~$3,000/month commitment. It's also a smart first step even if you might buy an enterprise tool later — run the free audit, see the gap, then decide.

**Choose Evertune if** you're a large brand or agency in a high-consideration category, you need statistically significant, high-volume analytics (100x prompt sampling, a consumer panel, deep historical trending), and you have the budget and procurement appetite for an enterprise contract. If a CMO needs defensible numbers to justify content investment, Evertune's depth is built for exactly that.

Many teams can reasonably start with AEOeye's free audit and only graduate to a platform like Evertune once AI visibility becomes a funded, strategic priority.

keyTakeaways: AEOeye is free, instant, and self-serve; Evertune is sales-gated with no public pricing and a reported ~$3,000/month minimum.
AEOeye runs a blind audit across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini in minutes — no demo, contract, or commitment.
Evertune is genuinely deeper: it samples each prompt ~100 times across 9+ engines (1M+ prompts/brand/month) for statistically significant metrics, plus a US consumer panel.
Evertune fits large enterprise brands and agencies (e.g. Canada Goose, Miro, WPP's Choreograph) that need data-science-grade analytics and can fund it.
AEOeye fits small/mid-market teams, solo marketers, and non-experts who just need a clear, fast answer on whether AI recommends them.
Honest trade-off: AEOeye trades statistical depth for speed/access; Evertune trades accessibility and cost for high-volume rigor and a (US-centric) consumer panel.

faqs.q: Is AEOeye really free, and what do I get?
faqs.a: Yes. AEOeye runs a free, instant audit that blind-queries ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini with the questions your buyers actually ask, then shows whether each engine recommends your brand, where you rank, and which competitors come up instead. No demo call or contract is required to start. Deeper multi-engine querying activates with usage.

Evertune doesn't publish pricing — access is sales-gated through a demo and contract. Multiple independent reviews report it starts around $3,000/month for a single enterprise tier, with no free trial and no self-serve signup. You generally can't see exact pricing without talking to their sales team.

faqs.q: Why does Evertune query each prompt ~100 times?
faqs.a: AI models give slightly different answers each time, so a single query is one noisy draw. Evertune samples each tracked prompt roughly 100 times across 9+ engines (1M+ prompts per brand per month) to average out that randomness and produce statistically significant, trendable metrics. That depth is its core strength — and a real advantage over any single-query snapshot for brands that need defensible numbers.

faqs.q: Is AEOeye a replacement for Evertune?
faqs.a: Not exactly — they're built for different jobs. AEOeye is the fast, free, accessible 'just tell me if AI recommends my brand' answer for small and mid-market teams. Evertune is a high-volume enterprise analytics platform with a consumer panel for large brands that need data-science-grade depth and can fund it. Many teams start with AEOeye's free audit and only move to an enterprise platform if AI visibility becomes a funded priority.

faqs.q: Does Evertune work for non-US brands?
faqs.a: Its engine coverage is global, but several reviews note Evertune's insights lean partly on a proprietary US consumer panel, which can make the consumer-behavior signal less relevant for non-US markets. AEOeye queries the AI engines directly with no US-panel dependency, so it isn't skewed toward a US audience.
